title: Tree Frog
prompt: Frog: A bright green tree frog sitting on a perfectly circular lily pad.
code:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 400" width="100%" height="100%">
  <!-- Water Background -->
  <rect width="400" height="400" fill="#e0f7fa" />
  
  <!-- Lily Pad Shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="200" cy="280" rx="140" ry="50" fill="#004d40" opacity="0.2" />

  <!-- Lily Pad -->
  <g transform="translate(0, -10)">
    <!-- Main Pad Base -->
    <path d="M 200 280 L 320 230 A 140 50 0 1 1 200 280 Z" fill="#4caf50" />
    <!-- Pad Inner Detail/Texture -->
    <path d="M 200 280 L 320 230 A 140 50 0 1 1 200 280 Z" fill="none" stroke="#388e3c" stroke-width="4" />
    <!-- Veins -->
    <path d="M 200 280 L 250 250 M 200 280 L 150 250 M 200 280 L 200 240 M 200 280 L 170 260 M 200 280 L 230 260" stroke="#81c784" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.6" />
  </g>

  <!-- Frog -->
  <g transform="translate(0, -20)">
    
    <!-- Back Legs (Thighs) -->
    <!-- Left Thigh -->
    <path d="M 160 240 Q 110 240 120 190 Q 130 160 150 180 Q 160 200 170 220 Z" fill="#2e7d32" />
    <!-- Right Thigh -->
    <path d="M 240 240 Q 290 240 280 190 Q 270 160 250 180 Q 240 200 230 220 Z" fill="#2e7d32" />

    <!-- Back Feet -->
    <!-- Left Foot -->
    <g transform="translate(120, 190)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="15" ry="8" fill="#4caf50" />
      <circle cx="-10" cy="5" r="4" fill="#4caf50" />
      <circle cx="0" cy="8" r="4" fill="#4caf50" />
      <circle cx="10" cy="5" r="4" fill="#4caf50" />
    </g>
    <!-- Right Foot -->
    <g transform="translate(280, 190)">
      <ellipse cx="0" cy="0" rx="15" ry="8" fill="#4caf50" />
      <circle cx="-10" cy="5" r="4" fill="#4caf50" />
      <circle cx="0" cy="8" r="4" fill="#4caf50" />
      <circle cx="10" cy="5" r="4" fill="#4caf50" />
    </g>

    <!-- Body -->
    <ellipse cx="200" cy="230" rx="55" ry="45" fill="#4caf50" />
    <!-- Body Highlight -->
    <ellipse cx="200" cy="220" rx="40" ry="25" fill="#66bb6a" opacity="0.5" />

    <!-- Front Legs -->
    <!-- Left Front Leg -->
    <path d="M 170 240 L 160 270 L 145 280" fill="none" stroke="#4caf50" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    <!-- Left Foot Details -->
    <circle cx="145" cy="280" r="4" fill="#2e7d32" />
    <circle cx="135" cy="285" r="4" fill="#2e7d32" />
    <circle cx="155" cy="285" r="4" fill="#2e7d32" />

    <!-- Right Front Leg -->
    <path d="M 230 240 L 240 270 L 255 280" fill="none" stroke="#4caf50" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" />
    <!-- Right Foot Details -->
    <circle cx="255" cy="280" r="4" fill="#2e7d32" />
    <circle cx="245" cy="285" r="4" fill="#2e7d32" />
    <circle cx="265" cy="285" r="4" fill="#2e7d32" />

    <!-- Head -->
    <ellipse cx="200" cy="190" rx="60" ry="35" fill="#4caf50" />

    <!-- Eyes (Bulges) -->
    <circle cx="165" cy="170" r="22" fill="#4caf50" />
    <circle cx="235" cy="170" r="22" fill="#4caf50" />

    <!-- Eye Whites -->
    <circle cx="165" cy="170" r="16" fill="#ffffff" />
    <circle cx="235" cy="170" r="16" fill="#ffffff" />

    <!-- Pupils -->
    <circle cx="165" cy="170" r="8" fill="#000000" />
    <circle cx="235" cy="170" r="8" fill="#000000" />

    <!-- Eye Highlights -->
    <circle cx="162" cy="167" r="3" fill="#ffffff" />
    <circle cx="232" cy="167" r="3" fill="#ffffff" />

    <!-- Mouth -->
    <path d="M 175 200 Q 200 210 225 200" fill="none" stroke="#2e7d32" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />
    
    <!-- Cheeks -->
    <circle cx="170" cy="205" r="6" fill="#ff8a80" opacity="0.4" />
    <circle cx="230" cy="205" r="6" fill="#ff8a80" opacity="0.4" />

  </g>
</svg>
